film: Kinso launch film, 46 s, 16:9: no voice-over, instrumental bed; type carries the narration on a soft coral/teal gradient ground, three logo appearances

shots.see: coral/teal gradient; none yet: the soft coral/teal gradient is the atmosphere
shots.words: Your next deal is in here somewhere

shots.see: gradient; the word 'here' grows huge, blurred, and splits to admit a vertical app stack (mail, chat, WhatsApp, Instagram)
gradient with coral halftone; the stack tilts into a white pill on a halftone dot field; a red redaction bar crosses a letter
near-black with a hex grid; a coral orb (the carrier) enters as a dot beside 'busy person'
shots.words: You are a really busy person

shots.see: near-black; the highlight chip stretches into a full-width bar
gradient; the bar's corner draws a bracket that becomes the logo mark
gradient; 'One inbox' pushes in big, then slides under the next line; an inbox window frames in
gradient; the orb returns as a small dot leading each word; inbox list stays beside
shots.words: It learns that matters to you

shots.see: gradient; the orb sits left of the line while the inbox list reorders
gradient; the orb becomes a cursor inside a phone mockup; WhatsApp in its own green
gradient; the orb grows into a full-frame sphere
gradient; the sphere settles behind a notification card
near-black with grid lines; a prompt box (the card) types the line and grows into a draft message
shots.words: It drafts replies that sound like you

shots.see: near-black; a count-up in the middle of the frame
near-black; the line grows huge and an iris wipe closes it
gradient; a blurred orb resolves into the mark; the url types in; holds

carrier.what: a coral gradient orb: a dot beside the lines, a cursor in the phone, a full-frame sphere, then the notification

signature_moment.what: the word 'here' grows huge and splits to admit an app stack: type and object share one frame

hook.what: 'Your next deal is in here somewhere' then 'Woah': the viewer's problem and a reaction, no brand

turn.what: 'Lets solve this first' on a bar that becomes the logo

proof.what: three capability beats: one line plus one simple UI proof each (inbox, ranking in a phone, a drafted reply)

close.what: social count-up 'Join 27,300 others on the waitlist', then the end card

image_use.how_moved: word-by-word builds, in-place swaps, giant blurred words that split to admit objects, count-up
clean recreated inbox, phone, notification and prompt box slide in beside the line that proves them
the orb as dot, cursor and sphere; mask wipes and an iris close

atlas_style_world.why: no atlas world is a soft-gradient atmosphere ground with kinetic type and one orb carrier
atlas_style_world.gap: see Minase: the launch default is not in the atlas; references/launch-grammar.md describes it

sound.structure: instrumental bed from 0.3 s with a pulse near 110 BPM; no spoken words (the whisper transcript is a mishearing of the music); hits at 7.3, 10.3, 12-15 (a rising run into the logo), 19-23, 27.8; a break at 27.4-28.5 s before the sphere; the bed stops about 2.7 s before the end
sound.mix_notes: about 2.4 designed SFX per 10 s (clicks, two impacts); picture lands on music events about 70 percent of the time; long quiet tail on the end card

what_to_take: The type is the narration and there is no voice: lines build word by word on a soft gradient ground.
One carrier travels the whole film (an orb: a dot, a cursor, a sphere, the notification) and hands off between beats.
Each capability is one line plus one simple UI proof recreated as a clean mockup, never a full-screen screenshot.
The ground flips to near-black for the problem and the capability that needs focus, then returns to the gradient.
Social proof is a count-up number; the last line closes with a mask wipe into a calm end card.
what_not_to_copy: its copy, its name or its mark
its app-icon stack and hex-grid dark ground
corrections: refs.mjs counted 5 cuts at the 0.4 threshold (1.1 per 10 s) and 8 shots. They are the dark ground flips at 8.2, 12.4, 32.1 and the end-card mask at 41.5: each is a carried or masked change. 8 shots in 46 s gives long 'shots' (the 17.5 s one is five beats of one scene): measure beats, not shots.
the whisper transcript ('I'm going to go') is a mishearing of the music: there is no voice. Sound mode is instrumental, and the type alone is the narration.
the scene-score shot list misses morphs, word swaps and masks: the beat table in beats.json is the real structure.
